newsitem.title: USA: Cade sees above average '97 results.
newsitem.headline: Cade sees above average '97 results.

text.p: Cade Industries Inc, which reported Wednesday first quarter earnings of $0.02 a share versus $0.01, said it expects to post above average earnings and revenue growth in 1997.
"Given the promising start to the year, we remain confident in our commitment to deliver above average earnings and revenue growth in 1997," said Cade President Richard A. Lund in a statement.

Cade had new orders of $17.1 million in the first quarter, contributing to a backlog of $40.2 million as of March 31. First quarter net income was $471,000, up from $186,000. Revenues rose to $12.4 million from $7.2 million.

Cade develops high technology composite components for the aerospace, air transport and specialty industries. It said its positive results are being driven by increases in production schedules and the growing strength in new aircraft orders.
Earnings increases resulted from the expanded volume, coupled with improving margins and continuing efforts to cut costs and boost productivity.
